items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-07-14
items.q: George Hartman played trumpet and bass.

ctx.x: Bill Bourgeois was there for a while too, playing in a mission. Yeah.
And I can't remember. Bill Bourgeois and George Hartman. What was George? What was George? Louis Escobeda. George Hartman played trumpet and bass. Yeah.
I remember him mainly as a bass player. He's dead. He's been dead quite a long time. Oh yeah.
